project_metadata._comment: 🔴 REQUIRED: Unique identifier for this optimization project
project_metadata._comment_date: 🔴 REQUIRED: Analysis date in ISO format
project_metadata.description: Description of the optimization goals and conditions
project_metadata._comment_desc: ⚪ OPTIONAL: Brief description of project objectives

_comment_input_1: DIA-NN output files (parquet, TSV, or CSV format)

input_data._comment: 🔴 REQUIRED: List of DIA-NN output files to process. Each file generates multiple optimization results.

instrument._comment_options: Options: astral, orbitrap, orbitrap_exploris, fusion_lumos, timstof, timstof_pro, sciex_7600, waters_synapt, custom
instrument._comment_custom: ⚪ OPTIONAL: Override preset values (null = use preset defaults)

_comment_dppp_1: Data Points Per Peak (DPPP) optimization targets

dppp_parameters._comment_dppp_modes: 1.5 = ID mode (max identifications), 4.0 = Balanced, 7.0 = Quant mode (best quantification, recommended)
dppp_parameters._comment_satisfaction: 🟡 IMPORTANT: Target percentage of precursors meeting DPPP goal
dppp_parameters._comment_tolerance: ⚪ OPTIONAL: Tolerance for DPPP matching (0.0 = exact match)

scan_settings._comment_load_options: 0.8 = Conservative (recommended for stability), 0.9 = Moderate, 1.0 = Aggressive (may cause instability)
scan_settings._comment_ms1: ⚪ OPTIONAL: Number of MS1 scans per duty cycle
scan_settings._comment_ms1_note: null = auto-detect (0 for parallel instruments, 1 for sequential)
scan_settings._comment_warning: 🟢 ADVANCED: Low window count warning threshold
scan_settings._comment_warning_note: Warning issued if window count falls below this value (not enforced)

rt_binning._comment: 🟡 IMPORTANT: RT bin width in minutes
rt_binning._comment_range: Recommended: 3-7 minutes for typical proteomics gradients
rt_binning._comment_tradeoff: Shorter bins = better RT specificity but more bins to manage; Longer bins = simpler but less specific

mz_optimization._comment_strategies: 🟡 IMPORTANT: m/z optimization strategies to apply
mz_optimization._comment_options: Options: greedy (MacCoss sliding), kde (density peak), quantile (percentile-based), outlier (robust), coverage (conservative)
mz_optimization._comment_recommendation: Use all 4 for comprehensive comparison, or select specific strategies for targeted optimization
mz_optimization._comment_quantile: 🟢 ADVANCED: Percentile range for quantile strategy (P5-P95 = 90% coverage)
mz_optimization._comment_coverage: 🟢 ADVANCED: Target m/z coverage for coverage strategy (95% recommended)
mz_optimization._comment_outlier: 🟢 ADVANCED: Standard deviation threshold for outlier removal (3.0 = 99.7% retention)
mz_optimization._comment_smoothing: 🟢 ADVANCED: Smoothing window size for DynamicDIA strategy
mz_optimization._comment_smoothing_note: Reduce if few RT bins (<5). Default 7 for standard gradients.
mz_optimization._comment_poly: 🟢 ADVANCED: Polynomial order for Savitzky-Golay smoothing (2-3 recommended)

_comment_wg_1: Isolation window generation modes and constraints

window_generation._comment_fixed: fixed = equal-width windows, variable = density-based adaptive windows (recommended for uniform coverage)
window_generation._comment_recommendation: Use both for comparison, or select 'variable' for optimal results
window_generation._comment_min_width: 🟢 ADVANCED: Minimum window width in Da (2 Da for narrow-DIA, 5-10 Da for traditional)
window_generation._comment_max_width: 🟢 ADVANCED: Maximum window width in Da (80 Da typical upper limit)
window_generation._comment_overlap: 🟢 ADVANCED: Overlap percentage between adjacent windows
window_generation._comment_overlap_note: 0 = no overlap (standard), 1-5 = slight overlap for edge coverage

output._comment_dir: 🔴 REQUIRED: Output directory for CSV files and summary
output._comment_plots: ⚪ OPTIONAL: Generate visualization plots (not yet implemented, default: false)

_comment_usage: USAGE: Modify values above, remove comment lines, and save as optimization_config.json
